dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Jagged, high-contrast white perimeters forming irregular circular and semi-circular shapes with a sharp gradient transition to darker, speckled interiors; most prominent in the central and lower-left regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of elongated, jagged high-intensity white streaks in the upper-right quadrant, and localized clusters of small, solid white spots along the lower ventral-lateral margin.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A near-linear vertical alignment exists between the centroids of two large annuli in the mid-left region; a large-scale obtuse triangle is formed by connecting these annuli to the vertex of a prominent V-shaped streak in the upper-right.

other_distinctive_markers: A continuous, jagged, high-contrast white linear feature resembling a 'Z' or lightning bolt shape extends diagonally from the dorsal midline toward the posterior lateral region.
